# momento_capacity_pool (Resource)

A Capacity Pool.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "momento_capacity_pool" "example_flex" {
  timeouts { create = "3m" }

  name = "flex-pool-name"
  provisioning = {
    flex = {
      capacity = {
        max_gib = 25,
        min_gib = 20
      },
      replication = {
        max_replicas_per_shard = 1,
        min_replicas_per_shard = 0
      },
      family = "standard",
      zones = [
        "usw2-az1",
        "usw2-az2"
      ]
    }
  }
  metrics_config = {
    cloud_watch = {
      iam_role_arn = local.metrics_iam_role
      region       = "us-east-1"
    }
  }
}

resource "momento_capacity_pool" "example_cluster" {
  timeouts { create = "3m" }

  name = "cluster-pool-name"
  provisioning = {
    cluster = {
      instance_type      = "t4g.medium",
      shard_count        = 1,
      replicas_per_shard = 0,
      zones = [
        "usw2-az1",
        "usw2-az2"
      ]
    }
  }
  metrics_config = {
    disabled = true
  }
}

locals {
  metrics_iam_role = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/MomentoMetricsRole"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the Capacity Pool.
- `provisioning` (Attributes) The provisioning configuration for the Pool's capacity. The mode is fixed when the Pool is created. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provisioning))

### Optional

- `metrics_config` (Attributes) Optional configuration for exporting CloudWatch metrics. When omitted, the Pool inherits your account-wide metrics config. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics_config))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

<a id="nestedatt--provisioning"></a>
### Nested Schema for `provisioning`

Optional:

- `cluster` (Attributes) A provisioning mode where you specify the instance type, shard count, replicas per shard, and AZ placement directly. Cluster mode is sometimes called "explicit mode". (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provisioning--cluster))
- `flex` (Attributes) A provisioning mode where you specify capacity and replication bounds, and Momento sizes the Pool within them. Flex mode is sometimes called "managed mode". (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provisioning--flex))

<a id="nestedatt--provisioning--cluster"></a>
### Nested Schema for `provisioning.cluster`

Required:

- `instance_type` (String) The instance type for the Pool's nodes (for example, r7g.xlarge).
- `replicas_per_shard` (Number) The number of replicas per shard.
- `shard_count` (Number) The number of shards in the Pool.
- `zones` (List of String) The availability zone IDs across which the Pool's nodes are placed. Must contain at least one zone.


<a id="nestedatt--provisioning--flex"></a>
### Nested Schema for `provisioning.flex`

Required:

- `capacity` (Attributes) The Pool's available capacity bounds, in GiB. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provisioning--flex--capacity))
- `replication` (Attributes) The Pool's replication bounds. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provisioning--flex--replication))
- `zones` (List of String) The availability zone IDs across which the Pool's nodes are placed. Must contain at least one zone.

Optional:

- `family` (String) The capacity family to use. When omitted, the Pool resolves to the cell's current default and pins it.

<a id="nestedatt--provisioning--flex--capacity"></a>
### Nested Schema for `provisioning.flex.capacity`

Required:

- `max_gib` (Number) The maximum requested available capacity, in GiB.
- `min_gib` (Number) The minimum requested available capacity, in GiB. Set equal to the maximum to pin capacity.


<a id="nestedatt--provisioning--flex--replication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `provisioning.flex.replication`

Required:

- `max_replicas_per_shard` (Number) The maximum replicas per shard.
- `min_replicas_per_shard` (Number) The minimum replicas per shard. Set equal to the maximum to pin replication.




<a id="nestedatt--metrics_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metrics_config`

Optional:

- `cloud_watch` (Attributes) Deliver this Pool's metrics to your CloudWatch account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics_config--cloud_watch))
- `disabled` (Boolean) Disable delivery of this Pool's metrics to your CloudWatch account.

<a id="nestedatt--metrics_config--cloud_watch"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metrics_config.cloud_watch`

Required:

- `iam_role_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM role that Momento will assume to export metrics.

Optional:

- `region` (String) The AWS region where the metrics will be exported to. When omitted, defaults to the region this Pool runs in.



<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
